focalSeamRatification.thesis: drift and warp are THE SAME mechanic — 'spring the focal node toward a target NODE' — differing only in what PICKS the target (a click for warp, a periodic auto-pick for drift). ONE focal-node position spring + a pluggable target-source.
focalSeamRatification.chosenDisposition: promote the FOCAL NODE to a first-class LIBRARY concept (field.focalIndex + a per-axis field.warp spring the engine steps inside stepField + warpTo/warpOnClick)
focalSeamRatification.rejectedAlternative: a generic single-consumer stepOverlay(field, k, now) mutate-the-field hook — the result[29] overfit anti-pattern (one consumer = slides). The focal-node-as-typed-field is STRICTLY LESS new API than a generic mutate-the-field callback; the adversarial least-new-API preference is honored by NOT shipping the generic hook.
focalSeamRatification.premiseCorrection: the §15 'first shipped in the slides constellation, GENERALIZE it' framing is a FACTUAL ERROR (grep-proven: warpTo|nearest|snapToNode = 0 hits in either repo). W17 AUTHORS the click-to-warp net-new; slides drift() is the architectural ANALOG, NOT a source to port.

springMath.model: 2nd-order critically-damped integrator: x += v*dt; v += (-2*zeta*omega*v - omega^2*(x - target))*dt, with omega = 2*PI/response, zeta = dampingFraction
springMath.useSpringForbidReason: useSpring wraps SpringProgress.play() which spawns its OWN rAF bound to a reactive ref — a SECOND rAF would DEFEAT the offscreen/tab-hidden/PRM freeze the useCanvas2D substrate provides. The keyframes.js (response, dampingFraction) PARAM model is reused but NOT its rAF; warpStep is advanced inside the substrate's single rAF (called from stepField).
springMath.liveTargetTracking: the warp stores the target node INDEX (not a click-time position snapshot); each frame warpStep re-reads field.nodes[targetIdx].{x,y} as its LIVE target, so it CHASES a drifting node and arrives ON it (the identity-ride).
springMath.dtClampRationale: a clamped dt guards a tab-throttle / offscreen-park-resume gap from teleporting the mark (a 5s resume dt is clamped to one 50ms step).
